summary.en: AI Robotics Engineer with an M.S. in Electrical Engineering, focused on ROS 2, Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, and Isaac GR00T for robot control, VLA, and Digital Twin data workflows. Experienced in end-to-end integration across perception, visual servoing, contact-aware insertion, data processing, policy inference, frontend/backend platforms, and simulation / real-world validation.
summary.zh: AI 機器人工程師，具電機工程碩士背景，專注於 ROS 2、Isaac Sim／Isaac Lab 與 Isaac GR00T 的機器人控制、VLA 與 Digital Twin 資料流程。具備從感知、視覺伺服、接觸式插接、資料處理、Policy Inference、前後端平台到虛擬／真實環境驗證的端到端整合經驗。

experience.company_zh: 瑞軒科技股份有限公司

en: Built ROS 2 control and simulation workflows for industrial and collaborative robot platforms with NVIDIA Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MoveIt 2, and cuMotion for motion planning, collision handling, and cable tasks.

Delivered Isaac GR00T N1.7 data conversion, model training, and policy inference, separately validating virtual-data training followed by real-world inference and real-data training/inference workflows.

Built a two-part training-data collection flow that automated robot tasks and recording through ROS 2, WebSocket, and related interfaces, fully automating multiple imitation-learning / GR00T / VLA training episodes and achieving 3-4x manual throughput.

Owned robotics software from requirements and architecture through Docker deployment, testing, on-site integration, and maintenance; integrated YOLO OBB / OpenCV visual servoing for HDMI insertion and AprilTag-based connector localization for cable tasks, improving cable-insertion success from 70% to 90% in a 10-trial test.
Integrated contact-aware insertion alignment with visual servoing and force-guided search, and validated the complete workflow on the physical robot.
zh: 建置 ROS 2 控制與模擬流程，整合工業／協作型機械手臂平台、NVIDIA Isaac Sim／Isaac Lab、MoveIt 2 與 cuMotion，支援路徑規劃、碰撞處理與線材任務。
完成 Isaac GR00T N1.7 資料轉換、模型訓練與 Policy Inference，分別驗證虛擬資料訓練後的真實環境推論，以及真實資料訓練與推論流程。
由自動化工作流程與資料錄製系統協作，透過 ROS 2、WebSocket 等介面完成多筆模仿學習／GR00T／VLA 訓練資料的全自動錄製，相同時間內資料蒐集量達人工操作的 3～4 倍。
獨立負責機器人軟體從需求、架構到 Docker 部署、測試、現場整合與維護；以 YOLO OBB／OpenCV 完成 HDMI 插線視覺伺服，以 AprilTag／OpenCV 完成線材接頭定位；線材插接成功率在 10 次測試中由 70% 提升至 90%。
整合視覺伺服與力導向接觸搜尋完成 HDMI 插線最後定位，並於真機驗證完整流程。
